breakdown.description: Counterflow configuration is stated but the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences are used.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the core inconsistency. The incomplete prompt correctly identified a counterflow heat exchanger but incorrectly provided the temperature differences for a parallel-flow configuration. The agent repeated this exact error, stating the heat exchanger is counterflow but then defining the temperature differences as 'ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,in and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,out', which is incorrect for counterflow. The ground truth correctly defines them as 'ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,out and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,in'.
